channel.title: SecurityWizardry Vulnerability Radar (RMFconsultoria)
channel.description: Alertas de vulnerabilidade (CVSS) - fonte NVD (fallback quando o SecurityWizardry está bloqueado) - RMFconsultoria

item.title: CVE-2026-135790 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | A vulnerability was detected in Panabit Smart Application Gateway TANGr7p10. This affects an unknown part of the file /cgi-bin/dashboard/ajax_chart_dump. The manipulation of the argument isntmeye results in os command injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

item.title: CVE-2026-136177 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | RayLabsHQ gitea-mirror before 3.38.1 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to make the server send HTTP requests by supplying a url to /api/gitea/test-connection or /api/github/test-connection. Attackers can target internal network services and cloud instance metadata endpoints, reading response content leaked through upstream error messages returned by httpGet.

item.title: CVE-2026-136178 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | Endurain before 0.20.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the PUT /api/v1/strava/link endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to modify Strava integrations using only a victim's strava_state value. Attackers can submit a leaked state with their own OAuth code to link an attacker-controlled Strava account, or an invalid code to remove the victim's integration.

item.title: CVE-2026-136179 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | EpicStaff 1.2.0 before 1.3.1 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in DocumentViewSet download and copy endpoints that allows authenticated users to access other organizations' documents. Attackers holding Knowledge Sources permissions in one organization can enumerate sequential document IDs to download or copy foreign documents, or insert documents into another organization's collection.

item.title: CVE-2026-136180 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Movary before 0.78.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated non-admin users to make the server request internal hosts by submitting crafted Jellyfin or Plex server URLs. Attackers can target internal services directly since URL validation is disabled by default, or bypass it via DNS rebinding, redirects, or AAAA records to probe internal network state.

item.title: CVE-2026-136181 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | cnpmcore 3.46.0 before 3.84.3 and 4.0.0 before 4.37.3 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain upstream registry authTokens via the GET /-/registry endpoints lacking AdminAccess middleware. Attackers can request /-/registry or /-/registry/:id and replay the leaked authToken as a Bearer credential to enumerate, download, or publish packages upstream.

item.title: CVE-2026-136182 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | HarnessRouter 0.4.2 before 0.32.2 contains an open redirect vulnerability in the self-hosted sign-in UI that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect users via the unvalidated next query parameter. Attackers can send crafted login links with an external, protocol-relative, or backslash-prefixed next value so victims are sent to attacker sites after signing in, enabling phishing.

item.title: CVE-2026-136183 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Mercur @mercurjs/core before 2.3.2 contains a missing object-level authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated vendors to access other sellers by substituting the :id path parameter. Attackers can read payment and tax details, overwrite profiles and addresses, and invite, remove, or re-role team members to take over another vendor's store.

item.title: CVE-2026-136184 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.4
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.4 | compose-farm 0.19.0 before 1.22.0 contains a cross-site WebSocket hijacking and cross-site request forgery vulnerability because its unauthenticated web UI performs no Origin validation. Malicious websites visited by users can open /ws/shell/{host} or /ws/exec sockets, or abuse unquoted service parameters and PUT /api/console/file, to execute commands on all managed hosts.

item.title: CVE-2026-136185 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | Prismor before 1.57.0 contains a wildcard CORS misconfiguration and missing authentication in its local HTTP API that allows remote attackers to overwrite security policies via cross-origin requests. Attackers can lure a developer to a malicious page that sends PUT requests to /api/policy/global or /api/policy/project, disabling AI agent guardrails and reading session and event data.

item.title: CVE-2026-136186 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | plugNmeet-server before 2.5.3 contains an authorization flaw in PollsController.HandleUserSubmitResponse that allows authenticated room participants to submit poll votes as other users by supplying an arbitrary UserId. Attackers can set UserId to another participant's id to cast votes on their behalf or block their legitimate votes, manipulating poll results.

item.title: CVE-2026-136187 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Spug 4.0.0 before 4.1.1 contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to execute commands by supplying a crafted git URL to the /api/credential/check/ endpoint. Attackers can inject shell metacharacters into the data field passed to git ls-remote with shell=True, executing commands as the Spug service account, which is root in Docker deployments.

item.title: CVE-2026-136188 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | Spug before 4.1.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated non-administrator users to read per-host SSH private keys through the GET /api/host/ endpoint. Users granted a host can read the cleartext pkey field returned by Host.to_view and log in directly over SSH, bypassing Spug's permissions and audit trail even after revocation.

item.title: CVE-2026-136189 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Schmitech ORBIT before 2.17.15 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in the permission_or_api_key dependency that allows any valid API key to access /admin management routes. Attackers holding a chat inference API key can read other keys in plaintext, rewrite config.yaml, and manage adapters and prompts to take over server administration.

item.title: CVE-2026-136190 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | RayLabsHQ gitea-mirror before 3.38.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the /api/sso/providers handlers that allows any authenticated user to access other users' SSO providers without ownership checks. Attackers can read every OIDC client secret in clear text and overwrite or delete providers, redirecting authorization and token endpoints to attacker-controlled servers.

item.title: CVE-2026-136191 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | GPAC through 26.07.0 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in gf_rtsp_do_deinterleave that allows malicious RTSP servers to hang clients by sending non-RTSP, non-interleaved data. Attackers can answer a client request with a few bytes not starting with '$', 'RTSP', or 'HTTP', causing the RTSP client thread to spin forever and consume a full CPU core.

item.title: CVE-2026-136192 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | GPAC through 26.07.0 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in SDP_ParseAttribute that allows attackers to cause unbounded memory growth via a NUL byte in an a=fmtp line. Attackers can supply a crafted .sdp file or malicious RTSP DESCRIBE response to hang gf_sdp_info_parse and exhaust memory, causing denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-136193 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the STAP-A handling of gf_rtp_parse_h264 in rtp_depacketizer.c due to unchecked aggregation unit sizes. A malicious RTP sender or RTSP server can send STAP-A packets with oversized NAL unit lengths to disclose adjacent heap memory or crash the client.

item.title: CVE-2026-136194 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in gf_rtp_parse_amr that allows remote RTP senders or malicious RTSP servers to read beyond packet buffers by sending crafted AMR/AMR-WB payloads. Attackers can send short packets whose TOC entries all set the F bit, causing out-of-bounds frame data to be copied into decoder output, disclosing memory or crashing the client.

item.title: CVE-2026-136195 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in gf_rtp_parse_mpeg4 that allows remote attackers to crash clients by sending MP4V-ES RTP payloads shorter than 4 bytes. A remote RTP sender or malicious RTSP server can send a short packet after a marker-bit packet, causing an unsigned wraparound in the VOP start-code search loop that reads past the buffer and causes denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-136196 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | GPAC through 26.07.0 contains an integer underflow vulnerability in gf_rtp_parse_mpeg4 that allows remote attackers to trigger excessive looping by advertising an undersized AU-headers-length. Attackers can send a crafted 22-byte AAC-hbr RTP packet from an RTP sender or malicious RTSP server to run about 2^28 iterations, pinning a CPU core and stalling clients.

item.title: CVE-2026-136197 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the glTF 1.0 importer that allows attackers to read adjacent heap memory by supplying an unchecked KHR_binary_glTF image bufferView. Attackers can craft a glTF or GLB file whose bufferView byteOffset or byteLength exceeds its buffer, disclosing heap memory through embedded texture data or crashing the process.

item.title: CVE-2026-136198 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Assimp 6.0.0 through 6.0.6 contains an invalid mesh reference vulnerability in glTF2Exporter::ExportMeshes that causes out-of-bounds access when meshes without faces are skipped during export. Attackers can supply a PLY point cloud or degenerate glTF 2.0 TRIANGLE_STRIP model exported to gltf2 or glb2 to crash the application or trigger out-of-bounds memory reads and writes.

item.title: CVE-2026-136199 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.7
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.7 | libical before 4.0.7 contains a denial of service vulnerability because icalparser_clean() does not reset the parser nesting level when reusing an icalparser. Attackers can submit a single malformed calendar with unclosed or mismatched BEGIN/END lines, causing later calendars to be silently dropped and memory to grow unbounded.

item.title: CVE-2026-136241 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | UWAS before 0.11.16 contains a WAF bypass vulnerability in the isAPContentType() function within internal/middleware/security.go that allows unauthenticated attackers to evade SQL injection, XSS, and shell/RCE body pattern detection by setting the Content-Type header to application/json, multipart/form-data, or other exempted types. Attackers can relabel the Content-Type of malicious requests to skip WAF body scanning entirely, causing the unfiltered payload to pass through byte-for-byte to the backend application without being logged as a WAF event.

item.title: CVE-2026-136271 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | Allot's Subscriber Management Platform (SMP) stores sensitive configuration credentials protected by a product‑wide, hard‑coded master password. The master key is constructed using a hard-coded string value plus a default key value. This results in an effective encryption key that is recoverable from shipped scripts and configuration files. The platform uses a deprecated and cryptographically insecure algorithm (PBEWithMD5AndDES) and no documented mechanism exists to change the key. An attacker with read access to configuration files, backups, or diagnostic bundles can recover credentials and TLS keystore/truststore passwords, and access to subscriber-management operations and subscriber PII.
